description: Defines a template class 'LinkType' within the 'Thunder::Core' namespace, implementing a generic link with serialization/deserialization, handling data transmission, and channel management.

classes.name: LinkType
classes.description: A template class representing a communication link with serialization, deserialization, and channel management.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns a reference to the link channel.

methods.name: Link (const)
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the link channel.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the channel.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Virtual method called when a request is received.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Virtual method called when a response is sent.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Virtual method called on channel state change.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an outbound object into the channel.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the channel with a wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the channel with a wait time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the channel has an error.
